name: Moody Krea2
description: Krea 2: создание по описанию или референсу и правка фото.

edit_profiles.label: Light edit
edit_profiles.description: Default for local changes to clothes, hair, makeup, expression, style or missing details; strong source conditioning.

edit_profiles.label: Replace the person
edit_profiles.description: Another person by description, or a body change that stays clothed: the photo holds less, so describe hands and eyes.

edit_profiles.label: Age and body
edit_profiles.description: Age and body shape: the photo holds weakly, the scene may shift.

edit_profiles.label: Remove
edit_profiles.description: Delete an object, garment or covering overlay while retaining strong source conditioning; describe the desired fill/result and put the removed thing in the negative. CFG 2.5, about twice as long.

edit_profiles.label: Different face
edit_profiles.description: Explicitly replace an already visible face with a different identity; weak source conditioning can shift the scene. Not for filling hidden details or removing overlays. CFG 2.5, about twice as long.

edit_profiles.label: Different pose
edit_profiles.description: Change the pose or head turn: CFG 2.5 and 16 steps, about 7 minutes per image.

edit_profiles.label: Person from the second photo
edit_profiles.description: Bring the person or face from the donor photo into the scene; name the donor's clothes or facial features in the command.

edit_profiles.label: Detail from the second photo
edit_profiles.description: Transfer only the requested tattoo, jewelry, garment or object/detail from photo 2; retain photo 1's scene with strong conditioning. Fidelity must be checked in the result.
